mapper.select: SELECT id FROM model_runtime.platform_model_deployment WHERE id = #{id} AND scope = 'PLATFORM' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE model_runtime.platform_capability_verification_reservation SET status = 'TIMED_OUT', outcome = 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED', completed_at = #{now} WHERE deployment_id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deadline <= #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_capability_verification_reservation (id, deployment_id, deployment_revision, actor_subject_id, actor_permission_version, target_fingerprint, inputs_digest, plan_fingerprint, quote_digest, quote_expires_at, sample_version, expected_sample_digests, reserved_fee, status, started_at, deadline) VALUES (#{r.id}, #{r.deployment.id.value}, #{r.deployment.version}, #{r.actor.subjectId.value}, #{r.actor.permissionVersion}, #{r.targetFingerprint}, #{r.inputsDigest}, #{r.planFingerprint}, #{r.quoteDigest}, #{r.quoteExpiresAt}, #{r.sampleVersion}, string_to_array(#{samples}, ','), #{r.reservedFee}, 'ACTIVE', #{r.startedAt}, #{r.deadline})

INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_model_capability_verification (id, platform_model_deployment_id, deployment_revision, platform_provider_connection_id, platform_provider_connection_revision, model_code, declared_capabilities, observed_capabilities, succeeded, result_code, elapsed_millis, probed_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{v.id.value}, #{v.deploymentId.value}, #{v.deploymentRevision}, #{v.providerConnectionId.value}, #{v.providerConnectionRevision}, #{v.modelCode}, string_to_array(#{declared}, ','), string_to_array(#{observed}, ','), #{v.succeeded}, #{v.resultCode}, #{elapsedMillis}, #{v.probedAt}, #{v.expiresAt})

INSERT INTO model_runtime.platform_model_deployment_verification_audit (reservation_id, verification_id, deployment_id, actor_subject_id, actor_permission_version, succeeded, occurred_at) VALUES (#{r.id}, #{verificationId}, #{r.deployment.id.value}, #{r.actor.subjectId.value}, #{r.actor.permissionVersion}, #{succeeded}, #{now})
